items.title: Bob Shoffner Interview, 1959-09-08
items.q: I don't remember Louis Chauvin. He could have been around there, but I didn't remember that.

ctx.x: Oh. Do you remember Louis Chauvin by any chance?
I don't remember Louis Chauvin. He could have been around there, but I didn't remember that.
He was a fellow came here at the Pekin Theater, I can't think now, Joe Jordan.
